value.rationale: This identifies the exact c_0 geometry of derivative spaces for every infinite restriction of the canonical one-counter matched-block language, not a chosen finite numerical invariant. It locates the associated noncompact Hankel maps simultaneously in the weakly compact and strictly singular ideals, a meaningful operator-ideal contrast to the sharp known 1/2 compact approximation gap. The parameter-independent support decomposition explains the phenomenon structurally and adds an explicit factorization to the recent geometric characterization of formal languages.
